verdict.rationale: Avalara documents an official AvaTax MCP server covering nexus handling and compliance data, with tools to retrieve nexus definitions and list or fetch transactions, so an agent can read nexus status and transaction history. The REST API also supports creating nexus declarations, which lets an agent act on that posture. The rest of the story is thin: filing appears only via a separate Managed Returns API, and a community report says AvaTax users still handle registration and filing separately. Missing for 10: registration status read access, accrued liability summaries, upcoming filing calendar via API/MCP, documented scoped or least-privilege agent credentials, independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server.
